sources.title: Mexico Embassy in Switzerland: visas

sources.title: South Sudan eVisa

sources.title: Ukraine MFA: Entry regime to Ukraine for foreign citizens
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine
sources.officialityEvidence: The official MFA page retains its detailed ordinary-passport table but labels it 8 June 2023; current automated retrieval returns 403.

sources.title: Ukraine MFA resumes issuing electronic visas
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine
sources.officialityEvidence: The official MFA notice describes resumed eVisa issuance but provides only an unenumerated 45-country total.

sources.title: Ukraine MFA: e-Visa
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Ukraine
sources.officialityEvidence: The official MFA eVisa page instead gives an unenumerated 43-state total; current automated retrieval returns 403.

sources.title: North Macedonia MFA: visa requirements for entry
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade of the Republic of North Macedonia
sources.officialityEvidence: The official MFA page explains general EU/Schengen and third-country-document conditions but does not reproduce a Kosovo passport result; live retrieval times out.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nationals of EU Member States and signatories of the Schengen Agreement DO NOT need a visa.

sources.title: Panama National Migration Service: Decrees and resolutions 2017

sources.officialityEvidence: The live Ministry mission page links this schedule, which identifies itself as updated February 2021 and has no later current-force adoption.
